records.article_diplomatic: Erſchrecken, wirkend. Mahäruje. Erſchreckt, erſchrocken mahejameke.
records.uncertainty_note: Exact accentuation in `Mahäruje` and the internal vowels of `mahejameke` remain pending independent collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Flachs. Dieſer mangelt, ſie machen aber Zwirn aus gebeizter Aloe, den ſie Sóco nennen.
records.uncertainty_note: The printed Rarámuri form at the end reads visually as `Sóco`; exact accentuation remains pending independent collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Friſch, das Aufmunterungswort, hiá, in der vielfachen Zahl hiáſi.
records.uncertainty_note: The final plural/exhortative form is read visually as `hiáſi`; independent collation is still desirable.

records.article_diplomatic: Früh, Beá, bealíki, oder taló tajenáſago, das heißt: es hat noch nicht getaget.
records.uncertainty_note: Exact diacritics in `Beá, bealíki, taló tajenáſago` remain pending independent collation.
The Rarámuri form is visually read as `Rachó`; exact medial consonant and accent remain pending independent collation.

records.article_diplomatic: Gegenwart, z. B. in meiner Gegenwart, ne batáni.
